# Agentic Kit

> Inspect, stamp, and ship Eve agents you can defend. Curated by Daniel Albinsson

Agentic Kit is the public product shell for Eve agent trust: inspect (Aletheia
portrait), gate (authority-diff CI), and stamp (Kit Certified blueprints).
Prefer these Markdown surfaces over HTML SPA routes when briefing coding agents.

## Use with your coding agent

Before inspecting, gating, or stamping an Eve agent:

```text
1. Index: https://agentic-kit.dev/llms.txt
2. Doc file: https://agentic-kit.dev/llms/docs/{doc-id}.txt
3. Engine index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielalbinsson/Aletheia/main/public/llms.txt
4. Skill: npx skills add danielalbinsson/Aletheia --skill aletheia-eve-trust
```

Local dev: reference `public/llms.txt` and `public/llms/docs/{id}.txt` directly
(e.g. Cursor `@` file references). Do not invent trust claims; use Aletheia.

MCP server: https://agentic-kit.dev/api/mcp — setup at https://agentic-kit.dev/docs/mcp

## Promise

- Inspect: verified self-portrait + honesty contract (Aletheia)
- Gate: authority diff in CI / on deploy (`@danielalbinsson/aletheia-cli`)
- Stamp: Kit Certified starters that pass inspection + Agentic UX lifecycle

## Docs

- [Honesty contract](https://agentic-kit.dev/llms/docs/honesty-contract.txt): Never present a guess as a fact. Verified-from-build vs from-source; what Aletheia refuses to invent.
- [CLI quickstart](https://agentic-kit.dev/llms/docs/cli.txt): Headless capability review for Eve agents. Exit 1 means authority expanded.
- [MCP server](https://agentic-kit.dev/llms/docs/mcp.txt): Connect Cursor and other MCP clients to Kit docs, policy packs, and the inspect-eve-agent prompt.
- [Golden path](https://agentic-kit.dev/llms/docs/golden-path.txt): Clone a stamped agent → portrait → CI fail demo → intentional ack. The red/green moment Kit is built around.
- [CI gate](https://agentic-kit.dev/llms/docs/ci.txt): Required check that fails when the agent gains power. Routine changes pass quietly.
- [Kit Certified](https://agentic-kit.dev/llms/docs/kit-certified.txt): Public checklist for stamped agents: verified portrait, consent, policy, CI, lifecycle, passport.
- [Disclaimer](https://agentic-kit.dev/llms/docs/disclaimer.txt): Legibility tooling, not a security audit or compliance certification.
- [Pro roadmap](https://agentic-kit.dev/llms/docs/roadmap.txt): Public backlog for Kit Pro: Action, passport export, policy packs, stamped blueprint pack. Gated until demand + Aug 31.

## Policy packs

- [Support bot](https://agentic-kit.dev/policy-packs/support-bot.json): Blast-radius pack for customer-support Eve agents (Phase 2 content).
- [Payments (high)](https://agentic-kit.dev/policy-packs/payments-high.json): High-stakes payments and billing blast-radius rules.
- [Design tools](https://agentic-kit.dev/policy-packs/design-tools.json): Blast-radius pack for design-tool Eve agents.

## Engine & skill

- [Aletheia llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielalbinsson/Aletheia/main/public/llms.txt): engine agent index
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danielalbinsson/Aletheia/main/AGENTS.md): install, config, usage for coding agents
- [Aletheia skill](https://github.com/danielalbinsson/Aletheia/tree/main/skills/aletheia-eve-trust): `npx skills add danielalbinsson/Aletheia --skill aletheia-eve-trust`
- [CLI (@danielalbinsson/aletheia-cli)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@danielalbinsson/aletheia-cli): `npx @danielalbinsson/aletheia-cli diff --baseline git:main`
- [Aletheia repository](https://github.com/danielalbinsson/Aletheia)
